title: CoAP /msg/custody resource handler
description: Implement the custody handshake endpoint. Accept POST with {id, dst, exp, body}. Write to custody store, respond 2.01 Created with Location-Path. Handle error cases: 5.03 storage full or TTL insufficient, 4.04 unknown destination. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.8.1. All three impls. Depends on: custody message store (ldhl.3).
